milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lily_of_the_valley flowers are placed at spawn-relative (2, 0, 2), (3, 0, 2), and (2, 0, 3). Target is set to (2, 0, 2) — the center of the flower cluster. max_distance reduced to 5 (from 16) because the scene is only ~12 blocks across and the flowers are ~2.8 blocks from spawn; a distance of 16 would be trivially satisfied at spawn without any movement. With max_distance=5 and facing_tolerance=60, the player must be within 5 blocks AND facing toward the flowers, confirming intentional observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The light_gray_concrete L-shaped wall spans from (-3, 0, 2) to (-3, 2, 4) and (-2, 0, 4) to (-3, 2, 4). Target is set to (-3, 1, 3) — the center of the wall structure. max_distance reduced to 5 (from 16) because the concrete is only ~4.2 blocks from spawn; 16 would be trivially satisfied. With max_distance=5 and facing_tolerance=60, the player must be within 5 blocks AND facing toward the concrete wall, confirming intentional observation.

Uses inventory_has because crafting light_gray_carpet results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player has 4 white_wool and 2 light_gray_dye in inventory. The crafting chain is: (1) light_gray_dye + white_wool → light_gray_wool (×2 batches), then (2) 2 light_gray_wool → 3 light_gray_carpet. The crafting table is at spawn-relative (-1, 0, 3). Checking for min_count=1 light_gray_carpet confirms the craft was completed. This item is not in the starting inventory so any presence confirms successful crafting.
